frames.text: A woman with shoulder-length black hair stands in the center-right of the frame, wearing a white V-neck blouse. She has a subtle, pleasant expression with a slight smile. Behind her is a rustic living room featuring a large stone fireplace with stacked brown and gray stones, a dark wooden mantel, and recessed ceiling lights. The ceiling appears to be dark wood paneling. The lighting is warm and natural, with the fireplace area slightly lit. The composition is a medium shot in portrait orientation.

The same woman appears slightly shifted to the right side of the frame, maintaining her pleasant expression and subtle smile. The stone fireplace is now more prominently visible on the left side, showing more of its full structure including the hearth area with a small fire visible. A window or doorway with bright natural light is visible behind the fireplace. The dark wooden ceiling and recessed lighting remain visible. Her white blouse contrasts against the darker background tones.

The woman is now positioned more centrally in the frame, with the stone fireplace visible behind her left shoulder. Her expression remains warm with a gentle smile, and her black hair frames her face naturally. The fireplace shows a small flame visible through the glass insert. The composition shows more of her white blouse, and the warm ambient lighting from the recessed ceiling lights illuminates the scene. The dark wood ceiling and gray-beige walls create a cozy interior atmosphere.
